text:
alex: Heads-up — coordinating a joint announce + integration playbook for LangChain / LlamaIndex + gateway/orchestrator partners. Can we do a short sync tomorrow 10:00am PT? Need demo owner, marketplace checklist, and compatibility matrix.

maria: I can own the demo and the marketplace listing. Will put together a quick runbook and assets.

cheng: I'll own the adapter compatibility matrix — function-calling surface, streaming, tokenization quirks, and required config flags.

sam: Sales asks — do we have partner-approved logos and a legal timeline for co-marketing? Also we need a one-pager copy.

alex: Legal review ideally by EOD Wed. @ria can you confirm dependencies and timeline?

ria: Confirmed — legal wants partner MSA + logo usage signoff before any co-branded materials. I can start the MSA checklist and request assets. Need logos/bios by Fri to hit the timeline.

devbot: Reminder: roadmap-bot scheduled "Partnerships sync" meeting tomorrow 2024-06-15 10:00 PT. (automated)

tanisha: For the demo, let's demo gateway fallback -> orchestrator handoff + a small orchestration policy that fails over to a cheaper model. Lightweight script, 3-4 steps.

cheng: Example gateway config snippet I[0m use for compatibility tests:

```
adapter:
  name: langchain-connector-v0.4
  features:
    - streaming: true
    - function_calling: partial
    - tokens: utf8-normalized
  fallback:
    - model: redwood/opt-quant-ttl
    - policy: latency-priority
```

cheng: I'll attach a CSV matrix with columns: partner, api_surface, streaming, functions_ok, notes.

maria: Nice. I'll draft a short integration matrix view for the marketplace docs and a demo checklist. Will upload to GH and link in this thread.

sam: :thumbsup: Please add a "perf notes" column — we need baseline perf for quantized vs float models from HW partners. I'll ping hw-alliances.

ria: Legal will need partner logos + short bios and explicit marketing consent. Can everyone collect by Fri EOD?

alex: Action items: maria -> demo + marketplace listing; cheng -> adapter matrix + prompt set; tanisha -> orchestration demo script; ria -> legal/MSA + asset collection; sam -> partner perf ask. I'll draft announcement copy once signoffs look good. Dry run Tue 9:00am PT. :calendar:

maria: Ack — uploading draft runbook now: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/tooling-playbook/pull/42

tanisha: Can someone add a 5-6 prompt set for demo quality checks? saves time during dry run.

cheng: Adding a small prompt set and a simple eval (rouge + embed-sim) to the matrix now.

alex: Great. If no major blockers, target announce ~2 weeks after final signoffs. Thanks everyone :rocket:
